recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for this issue; any future example showing both elements together would be illustrative rather than required to apply FHIR-17919.
issue_request: FHIR-17919 was a Published FM/STU3 change request asking for a way to include a PDF/HTML/etc. EOB with ClaimResponse. Its Persuasive with Modification resolution was to extend the current form attribute so both the code and an attachment can be sent at the same time, not as a choice.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly included in commit afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a on 2018-11-05. That bulk financial management commit changed ClaimResponse spreadsheet/source handling from the old form identifier to ClaimResponse.formCode plus a separate Attachment-valued ClaimResponse.form, and updated examples that carried a form identifier to use formCode.
additional_context: ClaimResponse is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition XML preserves the applied split: ClaimResponse.formCode is CodeableConcept and ClaimResponse.form is Attachment with wording for the actual form by reference or inclusion, including an EOB. Searches found no later Jira/community decision requiring a different current core change.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active source already implements the requested non-choice code-plus-attachment capability.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the same 2018 financial management bulk commit and also references EOB/ClaimResponse, but it concerns EOB and preAuthRef placement rather than ClaimResponse form attachments.
Surfaced in Jira search for ClaimResponse/EOB/attachment terms, but it concerns outcome/disposition/preAuthRef/preAuthPeriod on individual items and does not affect this form/formCode decision.
